parsed.why: No criminalisation of gender identity or expression, no documented targeting of trans visitors, broadly neutral attitudes, and a court-backed NGO. Missing protections are resident-facing; remaining exposure is dated hostility and open document/custody questions.

Sodomy statute plus no gender recognition puts trans people inside it; documented 2023 venue raids, warrantless searches, detention abuse, police outing leading to suicide, and incitement to kill. State-tolerated targeting with no recourse.

No presentation offence and ordinary border treatment, but documented hostile climate (survey: 46% avoid places for fear of assault), pride attacks, failed hate-crime enforcement, and a 2024 state 'propaganda' ban on gender identity.

Sodomy law up to 14 years, documented police rape and beatings of gay and trans people with victims framed as perpetrators, and general impunity — offset partly by third-gender traditions and a sanctuary village; data largely dated.

Statute criminalises changing sex at birth (5-10 years, no suspension), bans trans/LGBT organisations (10-20 years), and documents a current coordinated campaign: 40+ arrests, 16 imprisonments, judges punished for acquittals.
